description: Current develop rejects all valid BED0 Shale WAL segments after the BED1 replay-cursor format change, preventing restart of existing 0.5.3 data. Add clean format-version handling with explicit pattern matching. For validated, non-empty BED0 WALs, derive the compatibility cursor as first retained commit version minus one (zero remains zero), keep BED1 writes unchanged, and fail closed where a legacy cursor cannot be derived. Develop with tests first and cover mixed/edge cases.

comments.text: TDD evidence: initial compatibility tests failed at compile because WalFormat did not exist; after implementing format parsing, 17 focused tests passed. Mixed BED0->BED1 restart/replay then failed with transaction_not_after_cursor (900 emitted before 41), exposing newest-first segment traversal on the wire. Added a performance-contract test that failed by loading an irrelevant older segment. Cursor-aware newest-first selection now emits only the relevant prefix chronologically; 31 focused tests pass.

title: Read legacy BED0 WALs via synthetic exclusive cursor
